label: Multi-stage Node image
input:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM node:22-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:1.27-alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
USER 101
HEALTHCHECK CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1/ || exit 1
